title: Make fresh native builds order-safe
objective: Provide a supported fresh-checkout FLINT and full bootstrap path that establishes compiler prerequisites, builds the addon before generated FFI adapters, and publishes production kernels only after native adapters exist, with deterministic command-order tests and documentation.

runs.command: node --test --test-name-pattern=clean native and SEA build paths test/fflas-dense-prime.cjs

handoff.summary: Added a cross-platform FLINT composite that detects missing compiler artifacts, builds the root compiler before dependencies, guarantees node-gyp addon generation precedes FFI generation, and exposes a plan-only path. Reordered full bootstrap to build compiler/runtime prerequisites first, build FLINT then FFLAS then graph, and publish production kernels only afterward. Added deterministic mocked command-order tests and documented the supported build boundary.
risks: The dense-qq-resources integration baseline currently leaves dist/module-cache and dist/runtime-cache incomplete after pnpm build, so the required portable tier has unrelated existing failures and broad native/SEA receipts were not recorded in this lane.
next_steps: After rebasing onto a compiler-clean integration baseline, run pnpm test:portable, pnpm test:native, and pnpm test:sea on the target Linux/macOS/Windows builders.
